systems.name: Brass Lantern
systems.why_visit: Fuel and ammo on honest scales. The PDO gunnery range sells what it shoots.

bodies.name: Lamp Yard
bodies.legal: Helion Compact market lease. Fuel and ammo, weighed in public.
bodies.blurb: The fuel market orbits inside a lamp cage. Scales are bolted to the deck.
bodies.air: Lamp smoke vented on a schedule, not a sky.
bodies.face: Scale plates, brass rails, no ice.
bodies.crust: Fuel bladder rock under the market floor.
bodies.life: Clerks and range crews. No wild stock.
bodies.ruins: The first lamp tower, still burning as a price board.

bodies.name: Range Moon
bodies.legal: PDO range. Spent rounds are salvage if the range officer is off watch.
bodies.blurb: A gunnery moon. The craters are numbered, not natural.
bodies.air: Vacuum. The range is open to the guns.
bodies.crust: Nickel plug under the target face.
bodies.ruins: Retired cutter silhouettes used as marks.

belt.name: Lamp Slag
belt.composition: brass slag and lamp glass, shed by the gunnery range
belt.legal: Range scrap. Not a Compact exclusion.

trash.name: Range Scrap
trash.origin: Spent gunnery targets towed off Range Moon after each watch.
trash.legal: Range scrap. Wreck rights if the officer is gone.

pocket.name: Lamp Pocket
pocket.why: A fuel pocket. Compact scales. Not a homestead.

systems.name: Writ
systems.why_visit: Courts, the warrant office, and a yard of hulls the Compact already took.

bodies.name: Warrant House
bodies.legal: Helion Compact court. No claims. Seized hulls leave for Gyre.
bodies.blurb: The court orbital. Warrants are posted on the outer ring.
bodies.air: Paper air in the court. Vacuum outside the glass.
bodies.face: White stone and warrant ink, not ice.
bodies.crust: Archive stone. The warrants are the ore.
bodies.ruins: The first writ nail, still in the lintel.

bodies.name: Court Twin
bodies.legal: Sealed docket. Reading it is a scan, not a cut.
bodies.blurb: The dim half of the binary. It holds the sealed docket.
bodies.air: Thin noble gas, useless to a lung.
bodies.crust: Docket crystal, brittle.
bodies.ruins: A burned gallery from the last amnesty.

belt.name: Docket Chaff
belt.composition: shredded warrant foil and court glass, not stone ice

trash.name: Seized Yard
trash.origin: Hulls confiscated at Helion Dock and parked here until the tow to Gyre.
trash.legal: Compact seized property. The tender may strip what the court has tagged.

pocket.name: Docket Pocket
pocket.why: The court pocket. A core would be contempt.

systems.name: White Wake
systems.why_visit: Training patrols and a clean ice ring. The salvage here is bad on purpose.

bodies.name: Cadet Yard
bodies.legal: Helion Compact training lease. The ice ring is a counted cut.
bodies.blurb: A training orbital. The patrols shoot paint, then real guns.
bodies.air: Sterile drill air inside. None outside.
bodies.crust: Training ice under a metal skin. The ring is the real ice.
bodies.ruins: The first school buoy, still grading you.

bodies.name: Wash Rock
bodies.legal: Training mark. Not a claim.
bodies.blurb: A pale rock the cadets use as a turning mark.
bodies.face: Scoured white dust, not a second ice ball.
bodies.crust: Chalk and old paint.
bodies.ruins: Painted numbers from a retired syllabus.

belt.name: Cadet Chaff
belt.composition: training chaff and paint chips, deliberately poor salvage
belt.legal: Training chaff. Bad salvage, legal to read.

trash.name: Bad Salvage
trash.origin: Cadet wrecks the instructors marked worthless and left as a lesson.
trash.legal: Instructor-marked scrap. The lesson is that it is not worth the hold.

pocket.name: Drill Pocket
pocket.why: A drill pocket. The Compact will not lease a core here.

systems.name: Ledger
systems.why_visit: Bonded warehouses and grain futures from the Garden. The temptation is to skip the bond.

bodies.name: Bonded Loft
bodies.legal: Helion Compact bond. Garden grain may sit here. It may not be cut free.
bodies.blurb: A warehouse orbital. Grain futures are painted on the hull.
bodies.air: Dry warehouse air. The holds are colder than the star.
bodies.crust: The loft is hollow. The mass is other people's grain.
bodies.life: Bonded mold, watched. Not a crop of yours.
bodies.ruins: The first futures board, still wrong by a day.

bodies.name: Futures Moon
bodies.legal: Futures annex. Scanning is legal. Loading is not.
bodies.blurb: A small moon that stores the paper the loft will not show.
bodies.crust: Dry grain dust packed into rock.
bodies.life: Weevils in bond. They are inventory.
bodies.ruins: A cracked silo from a bad year.

belt.name: Bond Dust
belt.composition: spilled garden grain dust and stamp wax, not ice
belt.legal: Bond dust. A lease if the stamp is broken.

trash.name: Skipped Bond
trash.origin: Crates that left the Garden bond and were dragged back by a cutter.
trash.legal: Recovered bond. Cutting it is a Compact heat.

pocket.name: Bond Pocket
pocket.why: A bonded pocket. Grain sits. A core does not.

systems.name: Quiet Sun
systems.why_visit: A suburb that looks safe. The amber pocket is a gyre of decommissioned buoys.

bodies.name: Suburb Lamp
bodies.legal: Helion Compact suburb. The lamp is green. The buoy gyre is not.
bodies.blurb: A quiet orbital for crews who do not want the dock.
bodies.crust: Ordinary rock under the porch.
bodies.life: A few caged birds. Not stock you can buy.
bodies.ruins: The suburb's first lamp, dimmed on purpose.

bodies.name: Buoy Keeper
bodies.legal: Decommission pocket. Amber once the Compact cutter leaves.
bodies.blurb: The keeper rock behind the buoy gyre. It is not on the suburb brochure.
bodies.air: None. The keeper is a rock.
bodies.face: Buoy rust and old green paint.
bodies.crust: Hollow. The buoys were the product.
bodies.ruins: A keeper shack with the last duty log.

belt.name: Porch Gravel
belt.composition: suburb construction gravel and lamp clinker

trash.name: Buoy Gyre
trash.origin: Decommissioned Compact buoys, towed off the dock lanes and left to circle.
trash.legal: Decommissioned buoys. Amber when the cutter is not standing on them.

stream.name: Buoy Flakes
stream.origin: Flakes shed by the decommissioned buoy gyre on a down-spin timer.
stream.legal: Timed buoy flakes. They move. They are not a belt.

pocket.name: Hidden Porch
pocket.why: The amber pocket behind the buoys. Still not a homestead.

systems.name: Lease
systems.why_visit: Buy harvest paper from Tallyrock. The world is mined out and still sells the license.

bodies.name: Tallyrock
bodies.legal: Rimward Charter Authority. The paper is the product. The rock is spent.
bodies.blurb: A mined-out world that still sells harvest paper from a shuttered pit.
bodies.crust: The ore is gone. The charter office is the crust.
bodies.life: None wild. The clerks brought their own water.
bodies.ruins: The first pit head, now a license window.

bodies.name: Paper Moon
bodies.legal: Charter archive. The fine print lives here.
bodies.blurb: The moon where signed leases are stored because Tallyrock ran out of shelves.
bodies.crust: Wax and fiber, pressed until it acts like rock.
bodies.ruins: A vault door from a lease that expired mid-shift.

belt.name: Pit Tailings
belt.composition: mined-out nickel tailings and charter slag from Tallyrock's pits

trash.name: Expired Leases
trash.origin: Haulers that worked a Tallyrock lease a day past the stamp and were cut loose.
trash.legal: Expired-lease wrecks. The Charter will sell you the story.

pocket.name: License Pocket
pocket.why: You buy paper here. You do not plant a core on Tallyrock.

systems.name: Towline
systems.why_visit: Tug traffic. Tractor contracts. The Anvil was built for this road.

bodies.name: Tug Yard
bodies.legal: Charter tug lease. You may tow. You may not plant.
bodies.blurb: A yard of tugs. The contracts are tractor jobs, not guns.
bodies.crust: The yard is a plated rock. The ore was the cables.
bodies.ruins: The first bollard, still warm from a tow.

bodies.name: Bollard
bodies.legal: Tow mark. Anvil-friendly.
bodies.blurb: A rock worn into a bollard by a century of tow cables.
bodies.crust: Hard stone, cable-cut.
bodies.ruins: A snapped cable left as a ruler.

belt.name: Cable Clippings
belt.composition: cut tow cable and grease ice that is grease, not water ice

trash.name: Parted Tows
trash.origin: Tows that parted on the Lease road and were never reeled in.
trash.legal: Parted tows. Salvage if you hold the tractor paper.

pocket.name: Tow Pocket
pocket.why: A tug pocket. The homestead is the next buoy, not this one.

systems.name: Ore Choir
systems.why_visit: A dense metal belt. Claim-jump crews work the rim and do not pretend to be miners.

bodies.name: Choir Anvil
bodies.legal: Charter metal lease. The rim is where the jump crews wait.
bodies.blurb: A metal world hammered bright. The belt sings when the drills stop.
bodies.air: None. The anvil is bare metal.
bodies.crust: Solid metal crust. The belt is the spill.
bodies.ruins: A drill hymn cut into the face.

bodies.name: Rim Camp
bodies.legal: No charter. The camp is a jump cooperative.
bodies.blurb: A camp bolted to a metal shard at the belt's rim.
bodies.crust: Metal shard.
bodies.ruins: A jumped claim beacon, dark.

belt.name: Nickel Choir
belt.composition: dense nickel and drill spall from Choir Anvil, a metal belt
belt.legal: Charter metal on the inner belt. The rim is jumped.

trash.name: Jumped Rigs
trash.origin: Rigs taken by the rim cooperative and left when the Charter cutter was only a rumor.
trash.legal: Jumped rigs. Wreck rights at the rim.

stream.name: Nickel Rain
stream.origin: A nickel stream kicked off Choir Anvil by the drills, on a known vector.
stream.legal: Timed nickel rain. It moves. Do not park a probe in it.

pocket.name: Rim Pocket
pocket.why: The rim camp is not a garden pocket.

systems.name: Two Weathers
systems.why_visit: A tidally locked shard. Ember kale wants the hot face. Ghost gourd wants the cold.

bodies.name: Hot Face
bodies.legal: Garden Shards. A claim pocket, not a Compact exclusion.
bodies.blurb: The locked hot face. Ember kale is the reason to stand in the glare.
bodies.crust: Warm crust. Water hides from the light.
bodies.life: Ember kale will take here if you bring the seed.
bodies.ruins: A burned dome from a kale year.

bodies.name: Cold Face
bodies.legal: Garden Shards. The cold claim is the same shard's other cheek.
bodies.blurb: The locked cold face. Ghost gourd sets in the dark.
bodies.air: Cold enough to frost a visor. Not an ice belt.
bodies.crust: Cold crust. The frost is local, not a ring.
bodies.life: Ghost gourd if someone stays with it.
bodies.ruins: A dark orchard stake, snapped.

belt.name: Weather Gravel
belt.composition: hot cinder and cold frost-glass from the two faces, mixed only in the belt

trash.name: Split Domes
trash.origin: Domes that tried to farm both faces at once and split on the terminator.
trash.legal: Split homestead domes. The shard still takes a new core.

pocket.name: Terminator Pocket
pocket.why: The terminator pocket. Ember kale on the hot side of the stake, ghost gourd if you shade it.

systems.name: Broken Charter
systems.why_visit: Two charters name the same hollow. The dispute is the lesson.

bodies.name: First Stamp
bodies.legal: A charter that overlaps the second stamp. Planting starts the argument.
bodies.blurb: The older stamp. It says the hollow is already let.
bodies.crust: Claimed crust, twice.
bodies.life: A failed garden. The soil is still good.
bodies.ruins: The first stamp nail.

bodies.name: Second Stamp
bodies.legal: The second charter. Both papers are in the pocket.
bodies.blurb: The newer stamp. It says the first stamp expired.
bodies.face: Newer stamp paint over older iron.
bodies.crust: The same crust, a second name.
bodies.life: Nothing alive until someone tends it.
bodies.ruins: A surveyor nail bent by the first owner.

belt.name: Dispute Rubble
belt.composition: broken claim stakes and two colors of charter paint
belt.legal: Dispute rubble. Both charters claim the scrap.

trash.name: Two Papers
trash.origin: Haulers that carried one charter and were hit by the owners of the other.
trash.legal: Wrecks of a paper fight. The hollow is still plantable.

pocket.name: Overlap Hollow
pocket.why: Both charters name this hollow. A core here is a dispute, and it is allowed.

systems.name: Perimeter
systems.why_visit: The last garden before the Marches. Raid weather comes from rimward. The law here is red.

bodies.name: Last Stake
bodies.legal: Garden pocket under red law. A core can sit. A hail cannot.
bodies.blurb: The last garden stake. Past it the Marches do not write back.
bodies.face: Stake wood burned into the soil.
bodies.crust: Garden crust, already raided once.
bodies.life: What you bring. The wild things left.
bodies.ruins: A perimeter stake broken by a march raid.

bodies.name: March Echo
bodies.legal: Red. Not a Compact lane.
bodies.blurb: A rock that hears the Marches and answers with gravel.
bodies.face: Raid gravel cemented with old crop ash.
bodies.crust: Hollow. Used as a dump.
bodies.ruins: A march banner nail with no banner.

belt.name: Raid Scree
belt.composition: march raid gravel and burned garden ash, blown in from rimward

trash.name: Raided Domes
trash.origin: Garden domes cracked by march raids and left on the perimeter as a warning.
trash.legal: Raided domes. Red law. The tender can still work them.

stream.name: March Gravel
stream.origin: Raid gravel on a rimward vector, the weather the Marches send ahead of a hull.
stream.legal: A meteor gravel stream. It has a timer. It is not a belt.

pocket.name: Last Pocket
pocket.why: The last garden pocket. Red law. A core is allowed. A Compact hail is not.

systems.name: Gyre
systems.why_visit: The Swallow. A trash cyclone of Compact decommission and an older war. Bring a tender.

bodies.name: War Hulk
bodies.legal: Drift. No Compact exclusion. Wreck rights in the cyclone.
bodies.blurb: A war hulk too large to be trash and too dead to be a port.
bodies.air: None. The hulk leaks old air and then stops.
bodies.crust: The hulk is hollow. The cyclone is the resource.
bodies.life: None living. The Swallow ate the rest.
bodies.ruins: A fleet name, half scraped.

bodies.name: Decom Anchor
bodies.legal: Decommission anchor. The tow broke. The cyclone remained.
bodies.blurb: The anchor the Compact used when they started the decommission tow.
bodies.face: Tow scars and Compact green under the rust.
bodies.crust: Solid enough to hold a cable that is no longer there.
bodies.ruins: The decom order, still bolted to the face.

belt.name: War Slag
belt.composition: war slag and Compact decom plate, spun out of the Swallow

trash.name: The Swallow
trash.origin: Compact decommission yard plus the old war, spun into one cyclone.
trash.legal: The Swallow. Salvage rights. This is why you brought the tender.

stream.name: Swallow Teeth
stream.origin: Hull teeth thrown off the Swallow on a slow cyclone vector.
stream.legal: A moving tooth stream. It has a period. Park beside it, not in it.

pocket.name: Swallow Eye
pocket.why: The eye of the cyclone. Not a garden. A tender works the field.
